keyword: proof silver coins worth buying or not
angle: Proof silver coins carry steep premiums over bullion, but 2025-2026 US Mint sellout data and secondary-market resale gains show selective issues can outperform plain bullion for patient collectors.
secondary_kw: are proof silver coins a good investment

stats.claim: The 2026-W Proof American Silver Eagle was priced at $173 by the US Mint with a mintage cap of 500,000 coins, far above the roughly $30-$40 spot price of one ounce of silver.
2026 Proof Silver Eagle opening sales topped 334,000 units (295,410 individual coins plus 39,195 Congratulations Sets) before inventory was depleted.
Combined sales of the 2025-W Proof American Silver Eagle across formats reached 363,993 coins, demonstrating durable collector demand for proof issues.
The 2025-W Proof Laser Engraved Silver Eagle had a 100,000-coin mintage and released at $105, with first-day sales hitting 59,520 coins.
The 250th Anniversary Marine Corps 2025-P Proof Silver Eagle sold out in under an hour with reported sales of 92,601 against a 100,000 mintage cap.
Recent special-issue proof Silver Eagles saw secondary-market resale prices climb 40-60% within hours of selling out.
